name: The Molten Core
label: Quest
description: The Molten Core: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, perhaps it is time to give you a real test. Are you ready?
At the bottom of Blackrock Depths is a passage to the Molten Core. This is a stronghold of our enemy, held by the most powerful servants of fire on this world.
Go to the Molten Core, friend. Show me you have the strength and the will to defeat what you find there.
And if you have allies among your people, then rally them. Nothing short of an army can hope to enter the Molten Core and live.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Your success in the Molten Core awaits, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have done what most of your kind would think impossible. You have faced the beings of the Molten Core, and triumphed!
For so small a creature, you have displayed great resource.
Some day, perhaps we might strike a true allegiance between your kind and the Waterlords.
